name: LatchRun
note: PlayerStart_Corridor, run with `velox.move.Preset Q3` on server and client (VQ3: bAutoHop off, jump latch). Take-off, release, press again mid-air and hold; a server knockback (0,0,300) mid-air forces a correction with latch=false; first landing jumps (pre-press), second landing (jump held through the landing jump) does not.
